hook: Dog groomers: can you pass this *paperwork* quiz?
title: Groomer *paperwork* quiz

questions.q: Your business license is up for renewal. Does it renew on its own?
questions.why: Most need a form or a payment. Check your city or county.

questions.q: You run a mobile grooming van. What can expire besides your license?
questions.why: The van has its own dates, and they rarely line up.

questions.q: The insurance renewal email went to an old inbox. Are Saturday's grooms covered?
questions.why: Coverage depends on an active policy. Confirm before you book.

payoff: How many did you get? Comment your score.
